issues.on_page: 2600 Operation and maintenance of plant: budget 6,352,310

The split itself is correct and ties (8,939,736 on p7 vs 5,882,379 on p3; Depreciation Fund transfers in 3,057,357 on p9), but the printed budget figure is lost.

Included in the General Fund column's Local receipts on p3 (11,438,823 = General schedule local 11,081,572 + Depreciation interest 56,515 + EB interest 386 + contributions 300,350), with no elimination. Whether it is an interfund transfer or employee contributions is already raised in decision_needed. Detail[85] uses the same category.
